verdicts.reason: A squashes the 48H badge into an ellipse and crams it against the box at the top. The green panel runs full-bleed to the bottom, so the original's panel-on-stripes framing is lost and the CTA sits tight to the bottom edge. The body copy is also almost as heavy as the headline, so hierarchy is weak. B keeps the green panel framed by stripes above and below, gives the box room and has a well-stepped headline, body and CTA, but its badge is also distorted and jammed into the top-left corner against the canvas edge.
